{"id":2078428743,"question_id":3820,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"2 hours, 8 minutes","timestamp":1784813067,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"2070 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2078428743/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Number of Unique XOR Triplets II","memory":"98.3 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int uniqueXorTriplets(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int n = nums.size();\n\n        unordered_set<int>pairXor;\n        unordered_set<int>ans;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<n ; i++) for(int j = i ; j<n ; j++) pairXor.insert(nums[i] ^ nums[j]);\n\n        for(auto x : pairXor) for(auto num : nums) ans.insert(x ^ num);\n\n        return ans.size();\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"number-of-unique-xor-triplets-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2363}
